title: 4th Sitting of second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/4/2/2026).
First reading of the Bill to amend the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79), submitted on behalf of the government by Komandoo MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Preliminary debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Gadhdhoo MP Mohamed Ali.
Unfinished business: debate continues on the Personal Data Protection Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Henveiru West MP Ali Ibrahim.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was set to introduce an Export Import Act amendment, open debate on the Maldives 2.0 Digital Transformation Bill and continue debating the Data Protection Bill.
